posts.author: TriSelah
posts.body: Is there a way I could add an icon floating above a character or object as if there was an indicator to talk to them or that they have a quest for you in game? If not natively, then a plugin? Thanks

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: im sure there are plugins for it, but if you want a non-plugin approach, you can make alternate versions of your questgivers' sprite sheets to have the icon hovering over their heads. then you can use that sheet on the event pages that would be active if the quest is available
